note: What Noisefloor reads from the suite's other programs instead of collecting it again (doctrine kit tips.py): Cordon's navigational warnings and EASA airspace bulletins for declared-notice corroboration (NF-IND-5), and Watchfloor's escalating conflict zones for context.

interests.about: NGA navigational warnings reporting GNSS interference or testing at sea, for declared-notice corroboration (NF-IND-5)
EASA Conflict Zone Information Bulletins in force, covering airspaces where GNSS jamming or spoofing is warned of (NF-IND-5)
NGA navigational warnings on military exercises or rocket/space launches that may coincide with declared testing (NF-IND-5)
Conflict zones where Watchfloor flags an attention or violence anomaly, providing operational context for newly seen jamming
